perfil: Karin carries her fishing harpoon and charges in alongside the fierce Boss Shark. Together, they'll raise havoc on the battlefield!

habilidades.b:
Fires cuttlefish shells to deal DMG in a large area.
Karin can consume Hunting Energy to fire a chain that links with a target, increasing Karin's Auto Attack DMG while the chain is active.

tpl.s:
Fires cuttlefish shells, each dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Auto Attack DMG.

builds.d: A build focused on coordinated hunting with Boss Shark, boosting its DMG.
A build that boosts the effects of Hunting Energy & Hunter's Mark and enhances Auto Attacks.

l.b: Boss Shark's attacks summon a vortex of fish, dealing AoE DMG. Increases Karin's Ultimate Crit Rate against targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩.
l.s: Boss Shark's attacks summon a vortex of fish, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. This effect can only be triggered once every 1.5s. Increases Karin's Ultimate Crit Rate against targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩ by ⟦1⟧.

l.b:
After casting the Main Skill, Karin summons Boss Shark to follow her. During this time, Boss Shark periodically lunges at the Main Trekker's target, dealing AoE DMG.
Increases Karin's Ultimate Crit Rate.
l.s: After casting the Main Skill, Karin summons Boss Shark to follow her for ⟦0⟧s. During this time, Boss Shark periodically lunges at the Main Trekker's target, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Increases Karin's Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: After Karin deals Ultimate DMG several times, Boss Shark follows up with a tail strike that deals AoE DMG.
l.s: After Karin deals Ultimate DMG 5 times, Boss Shark follows up with a tail strike, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG  and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. This effect can only be triggered once every 2s. Increases Karin's Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Boss Shark deals DMG, increases Karin's Ultimate Crit DMG and the Ultimate Crit DMG of Umbra Versatile Trekkers.
l.s: When Boss Shark deals DMG, increases Karin's Ultimate Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧ and the Ultimate Crit DMG of Umbra Versatile Trekkers by ⟦1⟧ for 5s.

l.b: In an all-Umbra squad, increases the DMG multiplier dealt by Boss Shark to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩.
l.s: In an all-Umbra squad, increases the DMG multiplier dealt by Boss Shark to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Karin hits a target inflicted with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ with Auto Attacks, she can fire lob shots. When Karin inflicts ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ on a target, she can fire more Auto Attack bullets for a certain duration. Increases Karin's ATK and Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Karin hits a target inflicted with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ with Auto Attacks, she can additionally fire lob shots, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Auto ATK DMG. When Karin inflicts ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ on a target, she instantly gains ⟦1⟧ buff stacks. After that, she loses ⟦2⟧ buff stack every ⟦3⟧s. ⟦4⟧ stack increases the number of bullets fired by Karin's Auto Attacks by ⟦5⟧. When there is a target inflicted with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ on the field, increases Karin's ATK by ⟦6⟧ and Auto Attack DMG by ⟦7⟧.

l.b: Extends the duration of ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩. While Karin is linked to a target with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩, she deals DMG over time to all targets along the link path and restores ⟨Hunting Energy⟩. When Karin inflicts ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ on a target, increases her ATK and Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: Extends the duration of ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ by ⟦0⟧s. While Karin is linked to a target inflicted with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩, she deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Auto ATK DMG to all targets along the link path and restores ⟦2⟧ ⟨Hunting Energy⟩ ⟦3⟧, which can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. When Karin inflicts ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩ on a target, increases her ATK by ⟦4⟧ and Auto Attack DMG by ⟦5⟧ for 7s.

l.b: When an enemy target loses ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩, deals AoE DMG.
l.s: When an enemy target loses ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩, deals ⟦0⟧ of Karin's ATK as AoE Umbra Auto ATK DMG and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Increases Karin's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 8s.

l.b: In an all-Umbra squad, when Bait and Catch (Main Skill) is on cooldown, increases the DMG multiplier dealt by Karin's Auto Attacks to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩.
l.s: In an all-Umbra squad, when Bait and Catch (Main Skill) is on cooldown, increases the DMG multiplier dealt by Karin's Auto Attacks to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Karin triggers ⟨Umbra Mark⟩ on a target with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩, increases her Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Karin triggers ⟨Umbra Mark⟩ on a target with ⟨Hunter's Mark⟩, increases her Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Umbra Trekkers in the squad increase Karin's Umbra DMG and all Umbra Trekkers' Umbra DMG.
l.s: Each Umbra Trekker in the squad increases Karin's Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧ and all Umbra Trekkers' Umbra DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Karin triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases ATK.
l.s: When Karin triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 2 times.

l.b: Can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases Karin's ATK.
l.s: Karin can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases Karin's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: Increases the Umbra DMG dealt by Shark Assault (Ultimate) to elite or higher-tier targets. Increases Karin's ATK.
l.s: Increases the Umbra DMG dealt by Shark Assault (Ultimate) to elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦0⟧. Increases Karin's ATK by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: While Shark Assault (Ultimate) is active, continuously shoots bubbles to deal AoE DMG. Increases Karin's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: While Shark Assault (Ultimate) is active, shoots ⟦0⟧ bubbles every once in a while, each bubble dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Increases Karin's Ultimate DMG by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: When casting Shark Assault (Ultimate), increases Karin's ATK.
l.s: When casting Shark Assault (Ultimate), increases Karin's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 30s. Increases Karin's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧.
